familyResolution.reason: The named source confirms a 'bio-reactive gravitic slipstream system' and 'short-range slipstream operation' but does not explicitly identify the consolidated Black Light family key. The phrase combines gravitic and slipstream vocabulary that belong to distinct confirmed family operators elsewhere in the corpus; normalization would therefore be an attribution, not transcription.
admissibleComparisons: slipstream-shear: compare boundary/shear coupling, adhesion, detachment, Q-space/weather and wake evidence
gravitic-plane: compare geodesic/equipotential riding, shear forks, recoupling, gravitational terrain and gradient evidence
hybrid or installation-local control layer: consider that gravitic/inertial shaping may support a slipstream operator without being the transit operator itself
short-range non-FTL or transitional effect: preserve the possibility that 'slipstream' in this source is a local vessel term rather than the full interstellar FTL family
forbiddenPromotion: Do not set familyId to slipstream-shear solely because the source contains the word slipstream.
Do not set familyId to gravitic-plane solely because the source describes gravitic shaping.
Do not claim the Zwlei invented either family.
Do not infer classwide interstellar range from short-range slipstream wording.
Do not turn the derelict variant's surviving compartments into proof that every intact Mur'rek has identical damage-state behavior.

power.confirmed: Bio-reactive power fluids, conductive coolant, nutrient media, and hydraulic pressure share the documented vital-fluids distribution nexus.
power.derivedRule: A high energy reserve does not certify the regulator if cooling, hydraulic authority, or biological/metabolic support is below its required margin.

navigation.confirmed: The Navigation Current Well represents course solutions as moving currents whose speed, depth, and interference encode vector, gravity, and transit risk; its primary systems include gravitic reference, slipstream prediction, and inertial control.
navigation.derivedModel: C_nav = F(v, g, grad_g, sigma_sensor, sigma_model, vane_state, medium_state)
navigation.sourceAlignment: This directly supports the 'different lightspeed methods' requirement that transit safety margins depend on gravity, prediction quality, and family-specific sensor packages, but it does not by itself establish which consolidated FTL family performs the transit.

control.confirmed: Control is embodied through pressure-sensitive communal interfaces, moving-current navigation representation, flexible field vanes, command arbitration, and isolation/lockout systems.
control.derivedRule: Control authority should be modeled as distributed state regulation across vane geometry, working-fluid state, inertial reference, gravitic reference, and command authorization rather than as a single throttle scalar.

maintenance.rule: Repair that restores living material does not automatically restore regulator calibration; geometry, dielectric state, reference alignment, and vane symmetry require recertification.

signature.confirmed: The vessel's non-FTL cruise and station keeping are optimized for low signature.
signature.derivedRule: Low-signature cruise is not equivalent to zero signature and must not be generalized to undocumented transit modes. Fluid chemistry, biological metabolism, gravitic modulation, thermal rejection, communications membranes, and any actual slipstream/wake phenomenon remain separate observable channels.

scaling.interpretation: Larger installations increase vane area, working-fluid volume, structural span, sensor-baseline and synchronization burdens. Scaling should therefore be nonlinear and cannot be reduced to drive output proportional to vessel mass.

procedures.title: Regulator Pre-Operation Certification
steps: verify compartment pressure, wet-deck chemistry, and isolation state
sample dielectric, coolant, power-fluid, nutrient, and hydraulic media independently
survey field-vane geometry and compliance
calibrate gravitic and inertial references
exercise vanes at low authority and compare commanded versus observed symmetry
validate navigation-current representation against independent sensor solution
confirm protected abort and isolation authority before increasing field load

procedures.title: Asymmetric Vane Response
steps: freeze increase in field authority
compare vane response by sector and independent inertial references
isolate fluid and command channels feeding the divergent sector
reduce to the last verified symmetric state if still reachable
treat frame rotation as a navigation and structural hazard, not merely a drive-efficiency loss
recertify geometry, dielectric state, and references after repair

procedures.title: Vital-Fluids Cross-Contamination
steps: isolate the affected manifold branch
remove electrical authority where safe
sample and identify mixed media before flushing
treat electrically active foam as both corrosion and shock/field-coupling hazard
inspect downstream membranes, vanes, coolant passages, and sensor references
restore one fluid class at a time and document chemistry baselines

procedures.title: Derelict Regulator Survey
steps: assume no subsystem is inert solely because the vessel is abandoned
acquire passive gravitic, electromagnetic, chemical, acoustic, thermal, and field baselines
map trapped pressure and surviving fluid volumes before opening membranes
trace field-vane feeds and isolation boundaries without energization
treat surviving navigation-current or archive states as historical evidence rather than valid commands
export observations into the FTL evidence-instance and forensic chain without auto-selecting a family

generationRules.authorityOnly: Emit the source term 'bio-reactive gravitic slipstream system', the confirmed component names/functions, confirmed mission/environment facts, and confirmed hazards. Leave consolidated familyId UNRESOLVED.
generationRules.labeledDerivation: May derive fluidic-field machinery behavior, readiness dimensions, maintenance procedures, scaling burdens, failure propagation, and sensor/control relationships from the confirmed installation facts, with every derived result retaining source ancestry.
generationRules.labeledProposal: May propose Zwlei training material, patent classes, test rigs, refits, or improved regulator generations only when explicitly PROPOSED; invented names, dates, organizations, manufacturers, ranges, or family assignments may not be imported as canon.
generationRules.terminologyFirewall: Preserve 'gravitic slipstream' as a named-source term until an authority explicitly maps it to a consolidated family. The generator may compare it against family invariants but must not normalize by keyword.
generationRules.derelictRule: Derelict-condition observations are installation-instance evidence. They do not redefine intact class behavior unless a higher source generalizes them.

hardFailures: derelict state promoted to classwide canon

canonSafeguards: The named Mur'rek source outranks generic generator defaults for this class.
The source phrase 'bio-reactive gravitic slipstream system' is CONFIRMED and must be preserved.
The consolidated FTL family mapping is UNRESOLVED until explicit authority establishes it.
Gravitic vocabulary alone does not establish the gravitic-plane family.
Slipstream vocabulary alone does not establish the slipstream-shear family.
Confirmed short-range slipstream operation does not establish undocumented interstellar range.
Low-signature non-FTL cruise does not establish zero-signature transit.
Confirmed biological or fluidic embodiment does not establish inventor, manufacturer, date, or civilization-wide prevalence beyond the named class/source scope.
Derived equations express engineering structure and constraints, not recovered numeric canon.
Derelict observations remain scoped to the No Return Signal specimen unless separately generalized.
Repeated generated descriptions cannot promote UNRESOLVED family mapping to CONFIRMED.
Future explicit named canon may resolve the family and must then replace the unresolved mapping without erasing the original source wording.
